articles.headline: Hong Kong Teen Jailed Eight Years Over Acid Attack on Singaporean Tourist
articles.summary_html:
Hong Kong's High Court has sentenced a 19-year-old to eight years in prison for carrying out a corrosive-substance attackan assault in which a chemical such as acid is thrown or poured onto a victim腐蝕性物質襲擊 on a 36-year-old Singaporean tourist in June last year. Mr Justice Andrew Chan Hing-wai told the defendant, who had already entered a guilty pleaa formal admission of criminal responsibility made in court before trial認罪, that the attack had left the victim with burns that would cause a "lifelong impact" on her health and confidence, and that the case was serious enough to merit a lengthy custodial term.

The judge fixed the starting pointthe base term a judge selects for an offence before any adjustment量刑起點 at twelve years, reflecting the premeditated nature of the assault, before granting a one-third sentencing discounta reduction in punishment granted in exchange for an early admission of guilt刑期扣減 for the early admission. Defence counsel had argued that a lengthy term risked undermining the teenager's rehabilitation prospectsthe likelihood that an offender can be reformed and reintegrated into society更生前景, while prosecutors stressed the lasting harm caused by the attack.

The case has reignited debate over how the courts should balance deterrent sentencingpunishment designed mainly to discourage others from committing similar crimes具懲戒作用的判刑 against the reform of young offenders, particularly where visitors are targeted. Victim-support groups have called for tougher sentencing guidelinesofficial standards judges follow when deciding the length of a punishment判刑指引 for attacks involving corrosive substances, warning that lenient outcomes could erode traveller trustthe degree of trust that overseas visitors place in the safety of a city they travel to旅客信任 in the city as a safe place to visit.
articles.summary_zh_html:
香港高等法院判處一名十九歲青年入獄八年，罪名是去年六月向一名三十六歲新加坡女遊客潑灑腐蝕性液體，犯下腐蝕性物質襲擊。被告早前已認罪，法官陳慶偉告知被告，受害人身上的燒傷將對她的健康及自信造成「終身影響」，案情亦嚴重得足以判處長期監禁。

法官訂立量刑起點為十二年，以反映案件的預謀性質，再因被告提早認罪而給予三分之一的刑期扣減。辯方律師曾指出，漫長刑期可能損害這名少年的更生前景，而控方則強調襲擊造成的傷害影響深遠。

本案再次引發社會討論：法庭應如何在具懲戒作用的判刑與年輕犯人的改造之間取得平衡，特別是當受害者為訪港旅客時。受害人支援團體要求當局訂立更嚴厲的判刑指引，以處理涉及腐蝕性物質的襲擊案件，並警告輕判可能削弱外界對本港作為安全旅遊目的地的旅客信任。
articles.image_scene: The grey granite exterior of Hong Kong's High Court building in Admiralty on an overcast afternoon, with tall glass doors and a short queue of anonymous people in smart jackets climbing the front steps; a lawyer's black gown is visible among them, calm and orderly, nobody in distress, no signs or logos.

articles.headline: Hong Kong Sixes Opens With Record Twelve-Team Field as Cricket Carnival Returns
articles.summary_html:
The Hong Kong Sixes cricket tournament got under way today at the Tin Kwong Road Recreation Ground in Kowloon, with organisers fielding a record line-upthe largest number of participants or entrants a competition has ever had歷來最多隊伍的陣容 of twelve international sides. The host side, playing under the banner of Hong Kong, China, has drawn much of its squad from the core that represented the city at this year's Asian Games, giving the tournament a distinctly home-grown flavoura quality that reflects local talent rather than imported stars本土色彩 even as marquee overseas stars arrive for the three-day event.

Among the headline fixtures is a keenly awaited clash between India and Pakistan, whose star-studded squadsteams made up mainly of famous, highly skilled players星光熠熠的陣容 include several players drawn directly from this year's Indian Premier League. Organisers describe the event's unique six-a-side, six-over format as a deliberate attempt to keep matches fast-paced and accessible to spectators unfamiliar with the longer traditional game, part of a broader strategy to use the tournament as a gateway sportan easy, exciting introduction meant to draw newcomers into a larger activity入門運動 for local fans.

City officials have promoted the Sixes as a cornerstone of Hong Kong's mega-event strategya deliberate policy of hosting large international events to boost a city's profile and economy盛事策略, arguing that the resulting sports tourismtravel undertaken mainly to attend or take part in a sporting event體育旅遊 fills hotels and restaurants during an otherwise quiet autumn weekend. Sceptics, however, question whether the legacy benefitsthe lasting positive effects a large event is supposed to leave behind持續效益 of a three-day carnival reach grassroots cricket clubs, or whether public money spent on hosting rightsthe official permission and resources needed to stage a major event主辦權 would be better directed toward long-term development of local players.
articles.summary_zh_html:
香港板球「六人賽」今日在九龍天光道遊樂場正式開鑚，主辦單位安排了歷來最多達十二支國際球隊參賽，陣容堪稱歷來最多隊伍的陣容。東道主以「中國香港」名義出賽，陣中大部分球員來自今年亞運代表隊班底，即使多位海外明星球員相繼抵港，仍為賽事添上濃厚的本土色彩。

焦點賽事之一，是球迷熱切期待的印度對巴基斯坦大戰，兩隊均派出星光熠熠的陣容，當中數名球員更直接來自今年的印度板球超級聯賽。主辦方形容賽事獨特的六人、六個回合賽制，是刻意令比賽節奏明快、方便不熟悉傳統板球的觀眾理解，是整體策略的一部分，旨在將賽事變成吸引本地球迷的入門運動。

港府官員一直將六人賽宣傳為香港盛事策略的重要一環，強調由此帶動的體育旅遊在原本平淡的秋日週末，為酒店及餐廳帶來生意。然而，質疑者則關注一場三日嘉年華的持續效益，是否真能惠及草根板球會，又或者花在取得主辦權的公帑，是否應更多投放於本地球員的長遠發展。

articles.headline: Government Sticks to Just Two Land Sales for Fourth Quarter Despite Property Rebound
articles.summary_html:
The government has confirmed that only two residential sites will be released by public tendera process in which developers submit competing bids to buy or develop government land公開招標 in the final quarter of the year, maintaining a cautious land-supply approacha deliberately careful policy of releasing only limited amounts of land for development審慎的土地供應策略 even as the property market shows signs of recovery. Both parcels lie in Sha Tin: one is earmarked for conventional housing, while the other has been set aside specifically for a student hostel projecta development built to provide affordable, purpose-built accommodation for university students學生宿舍項目, reflecting long-standing complaints that tertiary students struggle to find nearby housing.

Officials say the modest offering is consistent with a calibrated supply strategyan approach that carefully adjusts the amount of land released according to market conditions經調節的供應策略 set out in the latest Long Term Housing Strategy report, which projects that roughly 419,300 flats will be needed over the coming decade against a supply target of 420,000. Property analysts note that a sudden release of extra land could risk an oversupply glutan excess of available units far beyond what buyers currently need供應過剩, depressing prices just as developer sentimentthe overall confidence or pessimism that property companies feel about the market發展商信心 begins to recover.

Critics counter that such caution ignores the scale of Hong Kong's housing backlogan accumulated shortage of homes that has built up over previous years房屋短缺累積, arguing that families on the public housing waiting list cannot afford to wait for the market to find its footing. Others welcome the restraint, warning that releasing land too freely could trigger a repeat of past boom-and-bust cyclesrepeated patterns of rapid price growth followed by sharp collapse大起大落週期 that left thousands of flats unsold for years.
articles.summary_zh_html:
政府證實，今年第四季只會以公開招標方式推出兩幅住宅用地，即使樓市出現復甦迹象，仍維持審慎的土地供應策略。兩幅地皮均位於沙田：一幅用於一般住宅發展，另一幅則專門預留作學生宿舍項目，回應大專學生長期難以在校園附近覓得居所的訴求。

官員表示，今次供應量雖少，但與最新《長遠房屋策略》報告所訂立的經調節的供應策略一致，報告預測未來十年香港需要約四十一萬九千三百個單位，而供應目標則為四十二萬個。地產分析員指出，若突然大增土地供應，可能令市場出現供應過剩，正值發展商信心開始回升之際，反而拖低樓價。

批評者則反駁，這種審慎態度忽視了本港累積已久的房屋短缺累積，指出正在等候公屋的家庭，根本無法等待市場自行復甦。另一批人則歡迎這種克制，警告若過於放鬆供應，可能重演過去大起大落週期所造成的後果，令數以千計的單位滯銷多年。

articles.headline: Foreign Caregiver Pilot Scheme to Roll Out Gradually From 2027, Labour Chief Says
articles.summary_html:
Hong Kong's Secretary for Labour and Welfare has confirmed that a long-awaited scheme to bring in foreign care workersdomestic helpers recruited from overseas specifically trained to look after elderly or disabled people外地護理工 for the elderly will be introduced gradually, with the earliest arrivals unlikely before the second half of 2027. Chris Sun said the government would run a small-scale carer intakea limited initial batch of workers introduced before any wider programme is rolled out小規模護理工引入計劃 admitting only a few hundred carers in its first year, with detailed arrangements to be settled after further consultation.

Under the proposed terms, carers would need to complete at least 150 hours of training before travelling to Hong Kong, and would earn 10 to 20 per cent more than ordinary domestic helpersforeign workers employed to carry out household duties such as cooking and cleaning外籍家庭傭工, reflecting the specialised nature of elder care. The scheme is intended to relieve the burden on an estimated 180,000 informal caregiversunpaid family members who provide day-to-day care without formal training or employment非正式照顧者 across the city, many of whom experience chronic carer exhaustiona state of physical and emotional exhaustion caused by prolonged, unsupported caregiving照顧者長期身心俱疲, with few accessing formal temporary care reliefshort-term professional care that gives a family caregiver a temporary break臨時暫託服務 in the meantime.

Employers' groups have cautiously welcomed the plan but warn that a sudden influx of better-paid carers could trigger wage spillover effectsupward pressure on pay in a related job market caused by changes elsewhere薪酬外溢效應 across the existing helper market, driving up costs for households that cannot afford specialised care. Advocates for the elderly counter that without such workers, Hong Kong's demographic ageinga demographic pattern in which the proportion of older people in society is steadily rising人口老化趨勢 will continue to strain families already stretched thin by long working hours and shrinking household sizes.
articles.summary_zh_html:
香港勞工及福利局局長孫玉菡證實，政府將分階段推出籌劃已久的輸入外地護理工計劃，供長者使用，最快亦要到2027年下半年才有首批人手抵港。孫玉菡表示，政府首年只會推行小規模的小規模護理工引入計劃，僅容許數百名護理工來港，具體安排仍有待進一步諮詢後落實。

根據建議方案，護理工須在來港前完成最少150小時培訓，薪酬將較一般外籍家庭傭工高出一至兩成，以反映長者照顧工作的專業性質。計劃旨在減輕本港估計十八萬名非正式照顧者的負擔，當中許多人出現照顧者長期身心俱疲的情況，而暫時甚少人能獲得正式的臨時暫託服務。

僱主團體對計劃審慎表示歡迎，但警告一旦大量薪酬較高的護理工湧入，可能在現有家傭市場引發薪酬外溢效應，令未能負擔專業護理服務的家庭百上加斤。長者權益倡導者則反駁，若無這批工人，本港人口老化趨勢只會持續加重家庭負擔，尤其是在長工時與家庭規模縮小的雙重壓力下。

trends.headline: 🎃 Hong Kong's First-Ever 'Halloween Month' Takes Over IG and TikTok
trends.summary_html:
For the first time, Hong Kong's tourism authorities have stretched Halloween into a month-long citywide campaigna coordinated promotional effort covering the whole city rather than a single venue全港性宣傳活動, spreading costumed parties across three consecutive weekends in Lan Kwai Fong alongside themed takeoversspecial temporary redesigns of a venue built entirely around one theme主題式改裝活動 at Disneyland and Ocean Park. Instagram and TikTok feeds have filled with elaborate costume reveals, queue-time videos and night-out recaps tagged to the district, with crowds already building ahead of the main night.

Organisers point to last year's roughly 80,000 revellerspeople celebrating enthusiastically, often loudly, usually at a festival or party狂歡者 as proof of the event's pulling power, and this year's extended format is designed to spread that crowd densitythe number of people packed into a given area at one time人流密度 over several nights rather than one. Police have confirmed crowd-management measuresofficial steps taken to control the movement and safety of large groups of people人群管理措施, a precaution local residents still associate with Lan Kwai Fong's deadly 1993 stampedea sudden, chaotic rush of people that can cause serious injury or death人踩人事故.
trends.summary_zh_html:
香港旅遊當局首次將萬聖節延伸成為期一個月的全港性宣傳活動，蘭桂坊一連三個週末舉行變裝派對，迪士尼樂園及海洋公園亦同步推出主題式改裝活動。Instagram及TikTok上充斥大量精心打扮的變裝影片、排隊片段及夜後感想，並標註地點標籤，正日前人潮已開始聚集。

主辦單位指出，去年約八萬名狂歡者的出席人數證明活動極具吸引力，今年刻意拉長活動期，正是為了將人流密度分散至多個晚上，而非集中於一夜。警方已確認將實施人群管理措施，這項防範措施，令本地居民不禁想起蘭桂坊1993年造成死傷的人踩人事故。

causes.label: Economic impact on local businesses
causes.text: Extending Halloween across an entire month gives bars, restaurants and costume retailers in Lan Kwai Fong weeks of extra trade rather than a single night's windfall, turning what was once a one-off party into a recurring, bookable attraction that hotels and tour operators can build autumn packages around.
causes.text_zh: 將萬聖節延長至整整一個月，讓蘭桂坊的酒吧、餐廳及變裝服飾店，得以享有數星期的額外生意，而非僅僅一夜的額外收入，令原本一次性的派對變成可供酒店及旅行社圍繞編排秋季套票的常規旅遊吸引點。

causes.label: Heritage vs globalisation in festival culture
causes.label_zh: 節慶文化中的傳統與全球化之爭
causes.text: Some commentators question why a borrowed Western festival now commands a full month of civic promotion while longer-established local observances, such as the Mid-Autumn or Chung Yeung festivals, receive comparatively little coordinated marketing, suggesting that commercial appeal rather than cultural roots increasingly decides which traditions a city chooses to amplify.
causes.text_zh: 有評論質疑，為何一個源自西方的外來節日，如今竟能獲得整整一個月的官方宣傳推廣，而中秋節、重陽節等歷史更悠久的本地節慶，卻甚少獲得同等規模的統籌宣傳，反映決定一座城市放大哪種傳統的，往往是商業吸引力，而非文化根源。

causes.label: Crowd safety risk in a dense nightlife district
causes.label_zh: 密集夜生活區的人群安全風險
causes.text: Spreading the festivities over three weekends is partly a safety measure, aimed at avoiding the kind of single-night crush that turned deadly in Lan Kwai Fong in 1993 and that echoed again in Seoul's 2022 Itaewon tragedy, yet any gathering of tens of thousands in a narrow, sloped district still carries real crowd-crush risk.
causes.text_zh: 將慶祝活動分散至三個週末，部分原因正是出於安全考慮，希望避免重演1993年蘭桂坊單夜人踩人慘劇，以及2022年南韓梨泰院踩死慘劇的悲劇，然而數萬人聚集於狹窄、斜坡地形的地區，依然潛藏著實際的人踩人風險。

causes.label: Counter-argument: over-commercialisation erodes authenticity
causes.label_zh: 反方論點：過度商業化削弱真實感
causes.text: Sceptics argue that stretching a single night into a month-long, tourism-board-branded campaign risks draining the spontaneity that once made Lan Kwai Fong's Halloween feel authentic, turning a grassroots night of costumed fun into a scheduled, sponsor-friendly product whose novelty may wear thin the longer officials try to extend it each year.
causes.text_zh: 持懷疑態度者認為，將原本一夜的狂歡拉長為整整一個月、由旅遊局冠名的宣傳活動，有可能削弱昔日蘭桂坊萬聖節那份自發而真實的氣氛，令一場草根式的變裝狂歡夜，淪為配合贊助商、按時間表進行的「產品」，而官方每年愈拉長活動期，其新鮮感便愈容易消退。

vocab.sample: The Tourism Board built an entire citywide campaign around the Halloween Month concept.
Disneyland's villain-themed takeover ran for several weeks ahead of the main event.

Critics say heavy festival branding can make a spontaneous night feel manufactured.
Hotels have built tourism packaging around the extended Halloween celebrations.
Long-time visitors worry that official planning is slowly draining the event's original spontaneity.

phrases.sample: A longer festival gives hotels and tour operators something to build packages around.

phrases.sample: Some long-time revellers feel the city trades a single unforgettable night for a predictable monthlong routine.
